The following events took place in '''26 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Battle of Kalarba|Destruction]] of [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]], its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Indobok]], and [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]].
*The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Duro (Yuuzhan Vong War)|established]] a [[Duro/Legends|base]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].
*The [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] was [[Invasion of Yavin 4|destroyed]] by the Yuuzhan Vong.
*The [[New Jedi Order]] was [[Invasion of Yavin 4|driven off]] Yavin 4 by the Yuuzhan Vong.
*The [[Jeedai heresy|''Jeedai'' heresy]] began among the [[Shamed Ones]].
*[[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] were [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]].
*The extinction of the [[Evocii]] with the Yuuzhan Vong's complete devastation of Nar Shaddaa.
*[[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] was brought under Yuuzhan Vong control.
*The [[Hutt underground|resistance movement]] was formed by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] on Nal Hutta against the Yuuzhan Vong.
*[[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] was overrun by the Yuuzhan Vong.
*Several individuals began to form a philosophy of "[[One Sith]]," which would eventually be organized into the [[One Sith|New Sith Order]].
